items.title: WA schools to go back to basics in classroom screen time crackdown

image.altText: A close-up shot of pencils in a white container on a school desk, with blurred students in the background.

children.content: WA will trial limits on classroom screen time for some primary school students next year, in a push to restore face-to-face teaching and hands-on learning.

items.title: WA man agrees to plead guilty to one charge over Thai teen's death

image.altText: A man sits in a singlet behind a desk looking at the camera

children.content: Australian Simon Carman has agreed to plead guilty to concealing a corpse, one of four charges laid against him in the trial over teenager Tunchanok Donhomla's alleged murder in Thailand.
